links.note: Tenzing's grandmother, who always has all sorts of interesting stories to tell, with humour and wisdom - this concept's line. Already linked and correct.
Shalini living with her family in a town in Kerala, the household preparing for Onam - this concept's setting. Already linked and correct.

Unwritten community practices giving secure access to shared resources while requiring specific duties of every family - both halves of the pair are this concept's sentences. Already linked and correct.

NSS and NCC as school communities - this concept lists the class, the sports community, the National Service Scheme, the National Cadet Corps and the science or drama club among the communities a reader belongs to. Already linked and correct.

A group meeting over a shared love of poetry is a community of common interest - this concept says a group of people of a particular religion, region, common work or interest may be called a community.

Why communities are interdependent - this concept says that in our complex societies everyone depends on a number of other people and communities, with the RWA depending on traders and municipal workers as its example.
Acchamma as the father's mother and Chittappa as the father's brother - this concept names each relation as it introduces Shalini's household. Already linked and correct.
The visible statement defines tyaga as sacrifice, which is this concept's gloss among ahimsa, dana, seva and tyaga. The item's other numbered statements are missing from the stem.

An apartment association electing office bearers and making rules for common facilities, security and cleanliness is a Residents Welfare Association, which this concept describes as a community that makes its own rules with the residents participating. Already linked and correct.
Tenzing's story set in a village in Meghalaya - this concept's setting. Already linked and correct.

Indian languages having many more kinship terms than English - bua, tau, tai, chacha, mausi, nana, nani, and Tamil distinguishing elder from younger siblings - this concept's observation and the conclusion it draws about relationships.
A jati, or a subdivision of it, often called a community - this concept's first example. Already linked and correct.
The grandparents' roles in Tenzing's household - storytelling, homework help, the school bus stop and social work in the colony - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.
Ahimsa paired with non-violence is the correct definition, and all four values in the options - ahimsa, dana, seva and tyaga - are glossed in this concept.

Shalini's parents buying clothes for Chittappa, Chitti and Chinni as well, so that everyone could get something new - this concept's story and Acchamma's explanation of it. Already linked and correct.
Community as a flexible concept covering groups based on religion, region, common work or interest, and school clubs - this concept's own argument. Already linked and correct.
Matching each community to its basis - scientific, farming, school team, religious - draws on this concept's list of the many kinds of community. Already linked and correct.
A school drama club as a community of common interest - this concept names the drama club among the communities a reader may belong to at school. Already linked and correct.

Developers who have never met but share a purpose form a community of common interest - this concept's point that community is a flexible concept covering groups of common work or interest rather than only neighbours.
Relationships among family members based on love, care, cooperation and interdependence - this concept's opening sentence. Already linked and correct.

Kamal Parmar, the owner of a small auto-fabrication workshop, starting evening classes himself - this concept's story, which is what shows community service can begin with an ordinary individual. Already linked and correct.
Tenzing's mother busy in a local handicraft cooperative making traditional fabrics and wood carvings for sale to tourists - this concept's detail. Already linked and correct.

The halma work being unpaid and done as a duty towards the community and the environment - this concept's point, which is what distinguishes it from an organised relief effort. Already linked and correct.

Matching jati, the scientific community, a residents' association and the farming community to their bases draws on this concept's list of the many kinds of community. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
The family as the fundamental and most ancient unit of any society - this concept's opening claim.
A joint family with several generations living together - grandparents, parents, uncles and aunts, brothers, sisters and cousins - this concept's definition.
A nuclear family limited to a couple and their children - this concept's definition.
Cousins being only brothers and sisters in most Indian languages, which emphasises the deep bonds among the children - this concept's explanation.
Cooperation glossed as working together - this concept's gloss. Already linked and correct.
